summary: st-test signs a tree that edits a check's lane like any other, once the base's evidence-wrap records the edited lane's digest (SIGNS_LANE_EDITS): it no longer leaves the check 'not signed' for CI (against an older base it keeps the old behaviour). The pre-push hook refuses an agent's push whose status leaves a lane edit to CI, so every push of ours is signed.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes; lane_definition_sha256 carries the edited definition's digest for a lane edit.

rules.detail: A lane edit is no longer covered by 'CI runs it' at push time: an agent's push needs a signed note for it (or ST_EVIDENCE_OVERRIDE).

compatibility.detail: st-test reads SIGNS_LANE_EDITS from the base's evidence-wrap and keeps the old behaviour against an older base.

manual.detail: None: the hook and st-test are read from the base.
